subject: Modules release gate: private VPC rollout (Terraform + Helm + Ansible)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Akhil Rao <akhil@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Modules release gate: private VPC rollout (Terraform + Helm + Ansible)

Hi Akhil,

We're preparing the private VPC rollout for the new on-prem/private offering and want to get Acme's network/security gating in place before we run the staged rollout next week. This thread contains the proposed infra-module changes (Terraform), Helm overrides for service mesh and Ingress, and an Ansible role to finalize host hardening.

High level changes:
- Terraform: new module "redwood/priv/vpc-modules" (adds subnet allocation, NACLs, flow-logs, TGW attachment hooks). See diff attached (modules_change_set.diff).
- Helm: values override to pin internal LB health checks and pod anti-affinity (helm-values-override.yaml).
- Ansible: role to create audit-only bastion and enforce sshd_config (disable password auth).
- CI: new pipeline job names: infra:priv:plan, infra:priv:apply, infra:priv:smoke. Sample pipeline YAML attached (cicd-pipeline.yaml).

Asks from Acme for gating:
1) Confirm network ingress CIDR constraints we must enforce (we currently use 10.10.0.0/16 split into /20s).
2) Confirm LB health-check source IP ranges so we can lock SGs.
3) Any additional IAM constraints for the service account performing Terraform (we want least privilege).
4) Any mandatory scanning/gating steps (SCA, container image SBOM, Terraform plan static check) before allowlisting.

I've attached the diffs and pipeline snippets for quick review. If you'd like, Vanessa can spin up a terraform plan in a sandbox account and attach the plan output.

Thanks — short on time here so quick call or a marked-up list would be great.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Cloud Platforms
Redwood Inference

Attachments: modules_change_set.diff (diff), cicd-pipeline.yaml (text), helm-values-override.yaml (yaml)

From: Akhil Rao <akhil@acme-cloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security <security@acme-cloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Modules release gate: private VPC rollout (Terraform + Helm + Ansible)

Jonas — thanks for the summary and the artifacts. Quick initial feedback after a quick pass: 

- CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16 is fine in principle but we need explicit per-subnet /20s and a documented plan for future expansion (we cannot accept open /16 allocations for customer-facing subnets). Please list the /20 allocations and their intended usage (control plane, compute, db, bastion).
- LB health checks: our infra team requires the healthcheck source to be limited to the ALB health check service IP ranges in our region; we will provide the exact CIDR list in a follow-up.
- Terraform service account: require no broad "*" privileges. Minimum needed: ec2:Describe*, ec2:CreateTags, ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute (bastion lifecycle), iam:PassRole for the TF-managed instance profile — we will send a suggested IAM policy.
- CI gating: we require a Terraform plan artifact uploaded to our secure bucket and a static scan of the terraform (checkov or tfsec) passing with no HIGH/CRITICAL findings before a plan may be applied. We also expect an SBOM for any container images used in the Helm charts.

Can you attach a terraform plan (or plan output) for the sandbox run and the artifact names so our pipeline can pick them up? Also please confirm whether the bastion is ephemeral (autoscaled on demand) or long-lived — we prefer ephemeral with session logging.

I'll loop in our infra owner to provide the ALB source CIDRs.

—Akhil
Akhil Rao
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Acme Cloud Solutions

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Akhil Rao <akhil@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Modules release gate: private VPC rollout (Terraform + Helm + Ansible)

Thanks Akhil — good notes. Quick answers and attachments attached: terraform-plan-output.txt (trimmed) is included for your sandbox run.

Responses: 
- Subnets: we have explicit allocation: 10.10.0.0/20 (control), 10.10.16.0/20 (compute), 10.10.32.0/20 (db), 10.10.48.0/20 (bastion). We'll include this mapping in INFRA-2247.
- Bastion: ephemeral by default (autoscaled ASG with lifecycle hook); a long-lived debug bastion can be enabled via flag. We will default to ephemeral and ship session logs to centralized S3 for 90 days.
- Terraform plan: attached (terraform-plan-output.txt). We used module version v2.3.1 of redwood/priv/vpc-modules and ran plan with -lock=false in a sandbox.
- IAM: our infra role avoids wildcard actions; current policy draft attached to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-examples).
- CI: pipeline job infra:priv:security-scan will run tfsec + trivy and fail on HIGH/CRITICAL. infra:priv:apply is gated by a manual approval step from Acme security.

Next steps I propose:
1) Acme confirms ALB healthcheck CIDRs (Akhil to confirm).
2) If security approves the sandbox plan, Vanessa will create a staged rollout in Acme's test account and upload plan artifacts to your secure bucket (JIRA INFRA-2247 will track).

If you'd like to take a short call later today (30 min) Vanessa and I can walk through the plan and pipeline.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: terraform-plan-output.txt (text)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Acme Security <security@acme-cloud.com>, Akhil Rao <akhil@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Modules release gate: private VPC rollout (Terraform + Helm + Ansible)

Thanks everyone — quick operational updates: 

- I've added a CI gating job (infra:priv:policy-check) that runs the IAM least-privilege linter against the TF state and will block applies if it detects iam="*" patterns.
- Added an Ansible role to enforce sshd_config and to rotate ssh keys for the bastion on provisioning; that role will run as part of infra:priv:post-deploy.
- We'll publish the plan artifact naming convention to the Drive folder and to INFRA-2247 so Acme can pick them up automatically.

If Acme can confirm the ALB CIDR list, we will finalize the SG rules and label the release candidate for your staged rollout. Vanessa — please schedule the sandbox apply for tomorrow morning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Deployments
Redwood Inference
